facts.summary: FDA issued complete response letter requiring new repeat-dose study · Filed (NDA) · neffy epinephrine nasal spray in anaphylaxis/allergic reactions · not yet approved
facts.indication: Type I allergic reactions, including anaphylaxis

evidence.summary: announced the receipt of a Complete Response Letter ("CRL") from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (the "FDA") regarding the Company's New Drug Application ("NDA") for neffy (epinephrine nasal spray)
evidence.program_discontinued: anticipates a resubmission to the FDA in the first half of 2024, positioning the Company for an anticipated FDA action date in the second half of 2024.
